account_tag_ids.help: Tags to be set on the base and tax journal items created for this product.

active.help: If unchecked, it will allow you to hide the product without removing it.

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

base_unit_count.help: Display base unit price. Set to 0 to hide it for this product.

base_unit_id.help: Define a custom unit to display in the price per unit of measure field.

base_unit_name.help: Displays the custom unit for the products if defined or the selected unit of measure otherwise.

description_sale.help: A description of the Product that you want to communicate to your customers. This description will be copied to every Sales Order, Delivery Order and Customer Invoice/Credit Note

free_qty.help: Quantity on hand minus outgoing quantity.

has_available_route_ids.string: Routes can be selected on this product

invoice_policy.help:
Ordered Quantity: Invoice quantities ordered by the customer.
Delivered Quantity: Invoice quantities delivered to the customer.

is_storable.help: A storable product is a product for which you manage stock.

list_price.help: Price at which the product is sold to customers.

lot_sequence_id.help: Technical Field: The Ir.Sequence record that is used to generate serial/lot numbers for this product

lot_valuated.help: If checked, the valuation will be specific by Lot/Serial number.

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

nbr_moves_in.help: Number of incoming stock moves in the past 12 months

nbr_moves_out.help: Number of outgoing stock moves in the past 12 months

optional_product_ids.help: Optional Products are suggested whenever the customer hits *Add to Cart* (cross-sell strategy, e.g. for computers: warranty, software, etc.).

property_account_expense_id.help: Keep this field empty to use the default value from the product category. If anglo-saxon accounting with automated valuation method is configured, the expense account on the product category will be used.

property_account_income_id.help: Keep this field empty to use the default value from the product category.

property_stock_inventory.help: This location will be used as the source location for stock moves generated by an inventory adjustment.

property_stock_production.help: This location will be used as the source location for stock moves generated by a manufacturing order.

purchase_method.help:
On ordered quantities: Control bills based on ordered quantities.
On received quantities: Control bills based on received quantities.

reinvoice_policy.help: Validated expenses, vendor bills, or stock pickings (set up to track costs) can be invoiced to the customer at either cost or sales price.

responsible_id.help: This user will be responsible of the next activities related to logistic operations for this product.

route_ids.help: Depending on the modules installed, this will allow you to define the route of the product: whether it will be bought, manufactured, replenished on order, etc.

sale_delay.help: Delivery lead time, in days. It's the number of days, promised to the customer, between the confirmation of the sales order and the delivery.

sequence.help: Gives the sequence order when displaying a product list

serial_prefix_format.help:
If multiple products share the same prefix, they will share the same sequence, otherwise the sequence will be dedicated to the product.

    * Legend (for prefix):
    - Current Year with Century: %(year)s
    - Current Year without Century: %(y)s
    - Month: %(month)s
    - Day: %(day)s
    - Day of the Year: %(doy)s
    - Week of the Year: %(woy)s
    - Day of the Week (0:Monday): %(weekday)s
    - Hour 00->24: %(h24)s
    - Hour 00->12: %(h12)s
    - Minute: %(min)s
    - Second: %(sec)s

service_type.help:
Manually set quantities on order: Invoice based on the manually entered quantity, without creating an analytic account.
Timesheets on contract: Invoice based on the tracked hours on the related timesheet.
Create a task and track hours: Create a task on the sales order validation and track the work hours.

show_on_hand_qty_status_button.string: Show On Hand Qty Status Button

standard_price.help:
Value of the product (automatically computed in AVCO).
        Used to value the product when the purchase cost is not known (e.g. inventory adjustment).
        Used to compute margins on sale orders.

store_by.help: Ensure the traceability of a storable product in your warehouse.

supplier_taxes_id.help: Default taxes used when buying the product

taxes_id.help: Default taxes used when selling the product

tracking.help: Technical field holding the tracking method. False on a storable product means it's tracked by quantity only.

type.help:
Goods are tangible materials and merchandise you provide.
A service is a non-material product you provide.

uom_id.help: Default unit of measure used for all stock operations.

uom_ids.help: Additional packagings for this product which can be used for sales

acknowledged.help: It indicates that the vendor has acknowledged the receipt of the purchase order.

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

company_price_include.help: Default on whether the sales price used on the product and invoices with this Company includes its taxes.

country_code.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.

date_order.help: Depicts the date within which the Quotation should be confirmed and converted into a purchase order.

date_planned.help: Expected delivery date of goods by the vendor based on the latest information

date_promised.help: Date promised by the vendor for at least 1 or more products to be delivered by.

default_location_dest_id_usage.help: Technical field used to display the Drop Ship Address

dest_address_id.help: Put an address if you want to deliver directly from the vendor to the customer. Otherwise, keep empty to deliver to your own company.

effective_date.help: Completion date of the last receipt order.

has_sale_order.string: Technical field for whether the purchase order has associated sale orders

incoterm_id.help: International Commercial Terms are a series of predefined commercial terms used in international transactions.

lock_confirmed_po.help: Purchase Order Modification used when you want to purchase order editable after confirm

locked.help: Locked Purchase Orders cannot be modified.

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

on_time_rate.help: Over the past x days; the number of products received on time divided by the number of ordered products.x is either the System Parameter purchase_stock.on_time_delivery_days or the default 365

origin.help: Reference of the document that generated this purchase order request (e.g. a sales order)

partner_id.help: You can find a vendor by its Name, TIN, Email or Internal Reference.

partner_ref.help: Reference of the sales order or bid sent by the vendor. It's used to do the matching when you receive the products as this reference is usually written on the delivery order sent by your vendor.

picking_type_id.help: This will determine operation type of incoming shipment

purchase_warning_text.help: Internal warning for the partner or the products as set by the user.

tax_country_id.help: Technical field to filter the available taxes depending on the fiscal country and fiscal position.

accrual_move_ids.help: Accrual entries generated for this line, so it isn't accrued again while one is still standing (posted, not yet reversed or cancelled).

date_order.help: Depicts the date within which the Quotation should be confirmed and converted into a purchase order.

date_planned.help: Delivery date expected from vendor. This date respectively defaults to vendor pricelist lead time then today's date.

date_promised.help: Delivery Date promised by the vendor. If the vendor delivers products after this date, their On-Time rate will be negatively impacted.

forecasted_location_id.help: Location used in the computation of the forecast.

is_storable.help: A storable product is a product for which you manage stock.

partner_id.help: You can find a vendor by its Name, TIN, Email or Internal Reference.

price_unit_product_uom.help: The Price of one unit of the product's Unit of Measure

product_no_variant_attribute_value_ids.string: Product attribute values that do not create variants

product_type.help:
Goods are tangible materials and merchandise you provide.
A service is a non-material product you provide.

qty_received_method.help:
According to product configuration, the received quantity can be automatically computed by mechanism:
  - Manual: the quantity is set manually on the line
  - Stock Moves: the quantity comes from confirmed pickings

qty_to_invoice_raw.help: Ordered quantity not invoiced. This may or may not include quantities that won't be invoiced, depending on the product's Control Policy.

selected_seller_id.help: Technical field to get the vendor pricelist used to generate this line
